app.name: Mannon
app.tagline: Wholesale quoting, without the email grind

install.body: Mannon runs your wholesale prices, registration forms, order limits and net terms inside Shopify — and gives your buyers an agent that answers “what's my price at 100 units?” without a support ticket.
install.hint: Enter the .myshopify.com domain, not your custom domain.

home.description: Your wholesale command center — KPIs, the Merchant Agent briefing, and what needs you today.

pricing.description: Every price rule in one place: volume tiers, custom prices, discounts, priority and combinations.

customers.description: Approve wholesale applications, manage groups and tiers, and keep tags in sync.

forms.description: Build and publish the registration form buyers fill in to apply for wholesale.

orders.description: Wholesale orders, order limits, net payment terms, quotes and draft orders.

storefrontAgent.description: Configure the Buyer Agent your wholesale customers chat with, and review every conversation.

analytics.description: Wholesale revenue, rule performance, the registration funnel and net-terms aging.

settings.description: Price display, discount combinations, notifications, translations, agent controls and the audit log.

plans.description: Your plan, what it includes, and an honest recommendation based on how you actually use Mannon.

scaffold.heading: Not built yet
scaffold.body: This page is a routing and layout placeholder. The {{feature}} feature set lands in phase {{phase}}.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.body: That page isn't part of Mannon. Use the app navigation to get back.

generic.heading: Something went wrong
generic.body: Mannon couldn't load this page. Reload to try again — nothing was changed.

trial.endingBody: After that, {{plan}} is ${{price}} a month. Nothing is deleted if you decide not to continue.

pastDue.heading: We couldn't take the last payment
pastDue.body_one: Your {{plan}} features keep working for {{count}} more day. Update the payment method in Shopify to avoid any interruption.
pastDue.body_other: Your {{plan}} features keep working for {{count}} more days. Update the payment method in Shopify to avoid any interruption.

cancelled.heading: Paid features are paused
cancelled.body: Your subscription ended. Nothing has been deleted — pick a plan and everything comes back exactly as you left it.

usage.heading: Your usage
usage.nearingBody: You've used {{used}} of {{limit}}. {{plan}} makes them unlimited.
usage.atBody: The {{plan}} plan allows {{limit}}. Upgrade to add more — what you already have keeps working.

change.proration: Shopify will credit you for the unused part of your current plan and show the exact amount to approve on the next screen.
change.takesEffectNow: Takes effect as soon as you approve the charge.
change.takesEffectAtPeriodEnd: You keep {{plan}} until {{date}} — the period you've already paid for — and move over after that.
change.takesEffectAtPeriodEndNoDate: You keep your current plan until the end of the period you've already paid for.
change.nothingDeleted: Nothing is deleted. Paused features and their data come back if you move up again.
change.overageHeading: Some of what you've built will pause
change.overageBody: {{item}}: you have {{overBy}} more than {{plan}} allows. They stay saved and stop applying until you move back up.

test.heading: Test subscription
test.body: This subscription is in Shopify's test mode, so no money changes hands.

error.heading: We couldn't start that change
error.body: Shopify didn't accept the request. Nothing was charged — try again, and if it keeps happening, contact us.

advisorSoon.heading: Plan advice is coming
advisorSoon.body: Once Mannon has a month of your usage, Claude will tell you whether your plan still fits — including when the honest answer is to stay where you are.

planTagline.free: One pricing rule and one form — enough to see Mannon work on a real product.
planTagline.growth: Unlimited rules and forms, CSV import, auto-tagging and order limits.
planTagline.pro: Net terms, shipping rules, draft orders, POS, Markets — and the Merchant Agent.
planTagline.agentic: The storefront Buyer Agent, PO-to-order, quote drafting and ERP sync.

locked.heading: {{feature}} is on {{plan}}
locked.body: Your plan doesn't include this yet. Everything else keeps working.

list.heading: Pricing rules
list.emptyBody: A rule decides what your wholesale buyers pay. Describe one in a sentence, or build it yourself.
list.emptySearchBody: Try a shorter search, or clear it to see every rule.
list.emptyArchivedBody: Archived rules stop applying and stay here for {{count}} days before they can be deleted.
list.usageUnmeasuredHint: Usage is counted once you have wholesale orders.
list.missingTargetsHint: Some products or variants this rule targets no longer exist in Shopify.
list.cachedHeading: Showing the last list we loaded
list.cachedBody: Shopify didn't answer just now. This list was loaded {{minutes}} minutes ago.
list.unreadableBody: They are not applying at checkout. This is a bug in Mannon, not something you did — contact us and we'll fix it.

builder.nameHelp: Only you see this. Buyers see it at checkout when the rule applies.
builder.statusHelp: A draft is saved but does not change any prices.
builder.tiersHelp: Buying more gets a better price. Ranges must not overlap.
builder.idsHelp: One per line. Use Browse to pick them in Shopify.
builder.tagsHelp: A buyer with any of these tags gets this price.
builder.scheduleHelp: Leave blank to start now and never end.
builder.priorityHelp: Lower wins when more than one rule matches.
builder.combinableLabel: Let this rule combine with other Mannon rules
builder.combinableHelp: Off means this rule applies on its own.
builder.leaveBody: Your changes to this rule will be lost.
builder.previewBody: What a buyer who matches this rule pays for a sample product.
builder.previewNoChange: This rule does not change this product's price.
builder.previewUnavailable: Preview unavailable — this does not stop you saving.

issue.amount_negative: Enter an amount of zero or more.
issue.end_before_start: The end date must be after the start date.
issue.no_targets: Choose at least one product, collection or variant.
issue.no_audience: Choose at least one buyer, tag or group.
issue.no_tiers: Add at least one quantity break.
issue.tier_min_above_max: The starting quantity must be below the ending quantity.
issue.tier_quantity_invalid: Enter a whole quantity of 1 or more.
issue.tier_currency_mismatch: Both amounts must be in the same currency.

conflict.heading: Someone else changed this rule
conflict.body: {{name}} was saved by someone else while you were editing. Nothing has been overwritten.

deleteModal.heading: Delete “{{name}}” permanently?
deleteModal.body: This cannot be undone. Type the rule's name to confirm.
deleteModal.label: Rule name
deleteModal.mismatch: That doesn't match the rule's name.

settings.heading: Priority and combinations
settings.orderBody: When more than one rule matches, the one nearest the top applies. Drag to reorder.
settings.combinationWarning: Combining rules can reduce a price to zero — review carefully.
settings.explainBody: Check what a buyer actually pays, and which rule decided it.
settings.explainNoRules: No rules match this buyer and product, so they pay the shelf price.
settings.explainClamped: Combined discounts reached zero. The buyer pays nothing for this item.

reason.no_matching_tier: No quantity break at this quantity
reason.cart_unknown: Needs a cart to know the subtotal
reason.no_price_in_currency: No price set in this currency
reason.not_combinable_with_winner: The winning rule does not combine

publish.neverPublished: No rules have reached checkout yet.
publish.failedHeading: Your rules were saved, but checkout wasn't updated
publish.failedBody: Buyers still see the previous prices. Try saving again, and contact us if it keeps happening.
publish.tooLargeHeading: Too many rules to send to checkout
publish.tooLargeBody: Your rules were saved but checkout still has the previous set. Archive rules you no longer use.

csv.heading: Import and export prices
csv.templateBody: Download the template, fill it in, and upload it back. The example row shows the shape.
csv.dropzoneHelp: CSV only, up to 10 MB and 50,000 rows.
csv.fileTooLargeBody: It is {{size}} MB and the limit is 10 MB. Split it and import each part.
csv.tooManyRowsHeading: That file has too many rows
csv.tooManyRowsBody: It has {{rows}} rows and the limit is {{limit}}. Split it and import each part.
csv.unknownTemplateBody: Download a template and use its column names, or pick which template this file follows.
csv.mappingBody: Every column below was matched to a field. Anything unmatched is ignored.
csv.withErrors_one: {{count}} row has a problem and will be skipped
csv.withErrors_other: {{count}} rows have problems and will be skipped
csv.nothingToImport: Nothing in this file can be imported yet. Fix the problems below and try again.
csv.importedBody: They are on your rules list. If this was the wrong file you can undo it for the next hour.
csv.undoneBody_one: The {{count}} rule this import created has been removed. Nothing else changed.
csv.undoneBody_other: The {{count}} rules this import created have been removed. Nothing else changed.
csv.undoExpiredHeading: This import can no longer be undone in one click
csv.undoExpiredBody: The hour has passed. You can still archive the rules individually from the rules list.
csv.tooLargeHeading: This import would be too big for checkout
csv.tooLargeBody: Importing these would make {{bytes}} KB of rules, over the {{limit}} KB Shopify accepts. Nothing has been imported. Archive rules you no longer use, or import fewer at a time.

column.skusHelp: One SKU per cell, or several separated by semicolons. Leave blank to apply to every product.

issue.missing_required: This is required and was empty.
issue.unknown_type: “{{value}}” is not a rule type. Use percentage, amount_off or fixed_price.
issue.bad_money: “{{value}}” is not an amount. Use a plain number like 8.00.
issue.bad_date: “{{value}}” is not a date. Use YYYY-MM-DD.
issue.unknown_sku: No product in your store has the SKU “{{sku}}”.
issue.invalid_rule: The rule this row would make is not valid: {{issue}}.
issue.ragged_row: This row has a different number of columns from the header.
issue.duplicate_row: This row repeats an earlier one.

warning.zero_value: The value is zero. If that is what you meant, nothing to do.
warning.duplicate_name: “{{name}}” appears more than once in this file. Both will be created.
warning.existing_name: You already have a rule called “{{name}}”. This adds another.
warning.last_wins: Quantity {{quantity}} appears twice; the later row (line {{previousLine}} was replaced) is used.
warning.ragged_row: This row has a different number of columns from the header, so values may be in the wrong place.

list.heading: Wholesale buyers
list.emptyBody: A customer counts as wholesale once they join a group or carry the “{{tag}}” tag. Share a registration form to start collecting applications.
list.syncingBody_one: {{count}} customer imported so far. The list fills in as it goes.
list.syncingBody_other: {{count}} customers imported so far. The list fills in as it goes.
list.syncingFirstBody_one: {{count}} customer so far. This runs in the background and takes a few minutes on a large store.
list.syncingFirstBody_other: {{count}} customers so far. This runs in the background and takes a few minutes on a large store.
list.staleHeading: Showing what we have on file
list.staleBody: Shopify did not answer, so this list is from our copy, last updated {{minutes}} minutes ago.
list.orphanedBody: They are priced by their tags alone. If their group was deleted, the tier pricing, terms and limits that came with it no longer apply to them.
list.noResultsBody: Try a different search, or widen the filters.
list.repriceNote: New prices apply on this buyer's next visit to your store.

groups.heading: Customer groups
groups.emptyBody: A group bundles pricing, payment terms, order limits and what a tier can see. Start from a template, or name your own.
groups.tagHelp: Members get this tag in Shopify, which is what your pricing rules target.
groups.termsHelp: Leave empty if this tier pays up front. Terms are enforced from phase 3.2.
groups.blockedBody: Deleting the group changes what these buyers pay. Choose where they go first.
groups.destinationNone: No group — price them on their tags alone
groups.duplicateBody: Two groups with the same handle would make it impossible to tell which one a pricing rule means. Pick a different name.

group.bundleBody: A group is a bundle. Each section is owned by the feature that enforces it.
group.noMembers: Nobody is in this group yet.

summary.noPricing: No live pricing rule targets the “{{tag}}” tag, so this tier pays retail.
summary.limits: An order minimum is set on this tier.
summary.shipping: Free shipping above a set subtotal.
summary.noShipping: No shipping rule on this tier.
summary.visibility_one: {{count}} collection is visible to this tier.
summary.visibility_other: {{count}} collections are visible to this tier.
summary.noVisibility: This tier sees your whole catalogue.

detail.spend_one: {{amount}} across {{count}} order, as recorded by Shopify.
detail.spend_other: {{amount}} across {{count}} orders, as recorded by Shopify.
detail.tagsHelp: Comma separated. These are written to Shopify, and your pricing rules target them.
detail.taxExemptOn: This buyer is not charged tax.
detail.vatRequiredHeading: A VAT id is needed first
detail.vatRequiredBody: This store requires a VAT id before a buyer can be marked tax-exempt. Add it to their account, then try again.
detail.noteHelp: Only your staff sees this. It is never sent to the buyer.
detail.deletedHeading: This customer was deleted in Shopify
detail.deletedBody: We keep the record so your history stays readable, but nothing here can be changed and no price applies to them.

tagging.heading: Auto-tagging
tagging.emptyBody: A rule tags buyers automatically from what they have spent, how often they order, or where they are. Tags are what your pricing rules target, so a rule here changes what someone pays.
tagging.valueHelp: An amount for spend, a whole number for counts and days, or comma-separated country codes.
tagging.unreadable_one: {{count}} condition could not be read — this rule is held back
tagging.unreadable_other: {{count}} conditions could not be read — this rule is held back
tagging.runNote: Tags are written to Shopify, which changes what these buyers pay.
tagging.previewBody_one: Checked {{count}} buyer against your rules. Nothing has been written.
tagging.previewBody_other: Checked {{count}} buyers against your rules. Nothing has been written.
tagging.ranWithFailures_one: {{count}} buyer could not be updated in Shopify and was skipped.
tagging.ranWithFailures_other: {{count}} buyers could not be updated in Shopify and were skipped.
tagging.lockedHeading: Auto-tagging is not on your plan
tagging.lockedBody: It unlocks on {{plan}}. Your existing tags keep working either way.
tagging.issuesHeading: This rule could not be saved

issue.no_conditions: Add at least one condition — a rule with none matches nobody.
issue.no_tags: Choose at least one tag to add or remove.
issue.tag_added_and_removed: “{{detail}}” is both added and removed by this rule.
issue.unreadable_condition: One of the conditions could not be read.

days_since_last_order.gte_one: No order for {{count}} day or more
days_since_last_order.gte_other: No order for {{count}} days or more
